items.summary: ウィスコンシン州の獣医不足地域において、Medford Veterinary Clinicが家畜診療能力拡大のためUSDA NIFAより$200kの助成を受け、可搬式家畜取扱機器や超音波診断機器の導入、獣医師研修、乳質検査等に用いる。
items.verbatim: ?NORTH-CENTRAL WISCONSIN WILL CONTINUE TO FACE A GROWING SHORTAGE OF VETERINARIANS WHO CARE FOR LIVESTOCK, CREATING CHALLENGES FOR NEARLY 655 DAIRY FARMS, 89 GOAT DAIRIES, AND MORE THAN 5,000 REGISTERED LIVESTOCK LOCATIONS WITHIN WI245, A FEDERALLY DESIGNATED VETERINARY SHORTAGE AREA.
